lab.title: Calculating with negative numbers
lab.kernfrage: Plus, minus, times and divide: how do you calculate with numbers below zero?
lab.intro: Choose a tab and a mode. In Discover mode you find the rules yourself; in Practise and Check you apply them.
mode.label: Mode
mode.entdecken_text: Try things out freely and find the rule yourself.
mode.ueben_text: Solve tasks and get feedback straight away.
mode.check_text: Mixed tasks. The results come at the end.
stufe.label: Level {n}
stufe.1: Plus and minus on the number line
task.zeichen_markieren: Tap each plus and minus sign. Is it an operation sign or the sign of a number?
task.punkt_ablesen: Read the coordinates of the point.
task.quadrant: Which quadrant is the point in?
task.spiegeln_x: Reflect the point in the x-axis.
task.spiegeln_y: Reflect the point in the y-axis.
task.figur_zeichnen: Plot the points in order and join them up. Which shape appears?
legend.positiv: Positive: filled, arrow pointing right or up
legend.negativ: Negative: outline with dot pattern, arrow pointing left or down
zs.blick_rechts: The figure looks right: the number is positive.
zs.blick_links: The figure looks left: the number is negative.
zs.gegenzahl_erklaerung: Minus {b} is the same as plus {gegenzahl}. Both ways lead to {ergebnis}.
zs.ziehen: Drag the figure to the result or type in the number.
kl.zeichen_gleich: Two identical signs next to each other become plus.
kl.zeichen_verschieden: Two different signs next to each other become minus.
kl.zeichen_falsch: Error: At least one sign is assigned incorrectly. The sign directly in front of a number in the bracket is the sign of that number.
kl.kontrolle: Check your result on the number line.
mal.vz_entscheid: Which sign does the result have?
mal.tabelle_leer: The table fills up as you solve the number pattern.
muster.klammern.frage1: Fill in the results. What happens to the result when the number after the minus gets smaller by 1? How does the series continue below zero?
muster.klammern.frage2: Fill in the results. What does it mean when you add a negative number?
muster.mal.frage1: Fill in the results. The result always changes by the same amount. Which sign does the result have when both factors are negative?
muster.mal.frage2: Fill in the results. Do you find the same pattern as in the first series? Which sign does the result have when both factors are negative?
regel.subtrahieren_negativ: Subtracting a negative number means: adding the opposite number.
regel.addieren_negativ: Adding a negative number means: moving in the negative direction.
regel.geteilt: When dividing, the same sign rules apply as when multiplying.
koord.figur_fertig: All points are plotted and joined.
err.betrag_statt_vz: The smaller number was subtracted from the larger one, so the sign of the result was lost.
err.minus_minus_minus: Minus before a negative number was calculated like a plain minus.
err.plus_klammer_betrag: The sign inside the bracket was ignored.
err.mal_vz: Minus times minus was calculated as minus.
err.div_vz: The sign is wrong when dividing.
err.koord_vz: The sign of one coordinate is wrong.
err.vorzeichen_falsch: The absolute value is right, but the sign is not.
err.rechenfehler: The sign is not the problem, but the absolute value is wrong.
err.erstes_vz_ignoriert: The sign of the first number was ignored.
err.spiegel_achse_vertauscht: The point was reflected in the other axis.
err.verschiebung_vz: The direction of one step of the translation is wrong.
hint.betrag_statt_vz: Go along the number line step by step. You start at the first number and walk backwards. Do you cross zero?
hint.minus_minus_minus: The minus in front of the bracket is the operation sign; the minus inside the bracket is the sign of the number. When you subtract a negative number, you reverse the direction. Try the Opposite button.
hint.plus_klammer_betrag: The minus in the bracket belongs to the number. Plus a negative number means: you move in the negative direction.
hint.mal_vz: Think of the number pattern: when the second factor gets smaller by 1, the result always changes by the same amount. How does it continue after zero?
hint.div_vz: Do the inverse check: multiply your result by the number you divide by. Do you get the first number?
hint.koord_vertauscht: x comes first (horizontal), then y (vertical). Read it again in that order.
hint.koord_vz: Check each coordinate: is the point to the left or right of zero, above or below?
hint.vorzeichen_falsch: The number fits, the sign does not. First decide: will the result be positive or negative?
hint.rechenfehler: Recalculate the numbers without signs and add the sign afterwards.
hint.erstes_vz_ignoriert: The first number has a sign too. Which number does the figure start on, and which way does it face?
hint.spiegel_achse_vertauscht: When reflecting in the x-axis, x stays the same; in the y-axis, y stays the same. Which axis is meant?
hint.verschiebung_vz: Look at the signs of the translation: plus means right or up, minus means left or down.
hint.zahlenstrahl.richtung: Which way does the figure face? The sign sets the direction it faces; the operation sign says whether it walks forwards or backwards.
hint.klammer.gegenzahl: Minus a number is the same as plus the opposite number. Convert the task first.
hint.klammer.vorzeichen_rechenzeichen: First mark every sign: operation sign or sign of a number? Then resolve the bracket.
hint.mal.vorzeichen_zuerst: Decide the sign of the result first, then calculate with the absolute values.
hint.div.umkehrprobe: Dividing is the reverse of multiplying. Which number times the lower number gives the upper one?
hint.koord.x_zuerst: First x (horizontal), then y (vertical). Left of the origin x is negative; below it y is negative.
hint.koord.quadrant: Look at the signs: right or left, up or down? Quadrants are counted anticlockwise; quadrant I is at the top right.
hint.koord.spiegeln: When reflecting in the x-axis, x stays the same and y changes its sign. In the y-axis it is the other way round.
hint.koord.verschieben_addieren: Translating means adding: add the first value to x and the second to y.
feedback.check_hinweis: In Check mode you only see the results at the end of the round.
result.tipp: Practise the tab where most mistakes happened, then start a new round.
strategie.1: How did you recognise which sign the result has?
strategie.2: Which task was the hardest? What did you do then?
strategie.3: How did you check your result?
strategie.4: What would you do differently with the next task of this kind?
strategie.hinweis: Your answer stays on this device and is not saved or marked.

lp.fehlertypen_text: Wrong answers are assigned to an error type. This shows you whether signs, brackets, multiplication rules or the coordinate system cause difficulties.

err.zeichen_rolle: A sign of a number and an operation sign were mixed up.
hint.zeichen_rolle: An operation sign stands between two numbers and connects them. A sign belongs directly to a number, for example at the start or right after an opening bracket.
koord.auf_achse: lies on an axis, in no quadrant
err.koord_falsch: The point is in a different place: at least one coordinate is wrong even without its sign.
hint.koord_falsch: Count from the origin: first across to x, then up or down to y. Then check the signs.
